content:
xia-chao opened issue #14899:

noticed SIGTERM kills wasmtime serve right away: in-flight requests get cut and it exits 143. ctrl-c is graceful, but systemd and docker send SIGTERM.

is that on purpose? or should SIGTERM go through the same graceful path?

alexcrichton commented on issue #14899:

Ah just an oversight, I think that'd make sense to go through the same path
